root.label: Forwarding References
root.note: Perfect forwarding encodes the caller's value category into a deduced type T and unpacks it with std::forward.

children.label: Syntactic Conditions
children.note: Only bare cv-unqualified T&& deduced at that function call acts as a forwarding reference.

children.label: Deduced Function T&&
children.note: T must be a template parameter of the function itself written directly as T&&.

children.label: auto&& Variables & Lambdas
children.note: auto&& obeys the exact same template deduction and collapsing rules for variables and generic lambdas.

children.label: Disqualified Forms
children.note: const T&&, vector<T>&&, and class-template Box<T>::push(T&&) are plain rvalue references.

children.label: Deduction & Collapsing
children.note: A special deduction rule pairs with reference collapsing to bind both lvalues and rvalues.

children.label: Lvalue Deduces T&
children.note: Passing an lvalue U deduces T as U&, making T&& collapse to U&.

children.label: Rvalue Deduces T
children.note: Passing a prvalue or xvalue U deduces T as U, leaving T&& as U&&.

children.label: Infectious Lvalue Collapse
children.note: Any reference-to-reference containing & collapses to &; only && plus && stays &&.

children.label: Forwarding Mechanics
children.note: Named parameters become lvalues inside bodies and must be cast back selectively.

children.label: Named Param Is Lvalue
children.note: Every named function parameter—even typed Widget&&—acts as an lvalue expression inside the body.

children.label: std::forward Cast
children.note: std::forward<T>(arg) performs static_cast<T&&>(arg) and forbids turning rvalues into lvalue refs.

children.label: C++23 forward_like
children.note: std::forward_like<Self>(member) transfers Self's constness and value category onto a subobject or ref.

children.label: Variadic Forwarding
children.note: Parameter packs forward arbitrary argument lists intact into constructors and factories.

children.label: Pack Expansion
children.note: Writing std::forward<Args>(args)... forwards every argument with its independent value category.

children.label: Non-Deduced Braces
children.note: Braced initializer lists like {1, 2} cannot deduce T&& and fail template deduction.

children.label: Common Traps
children.note: Unconstrained forwarding signatures silently steal copies or introduce double-move bugs.

children.label: Greedy Copy Hijack
children.note: An unconstrained T&& constructor beats const T& when copying a non-const lvalue.

children.label: Double Forward Bug
children.note: Forwarding the same parameter twice can read from an already moved-from rvalue.

children.label: Dangling Forwarded Ref
children.note: Returning a forwarded rvalue reference from a local temporary creates immediate dangling.
